description: Rank the biggest OPEN-MARKET insider purchases across every US public company at once — "which insiders bought the most stock recently", "who was buying their own company's shares", "how much of X did Y buy". Returns the insider name and role, the issuer and ticker, shares, price per share and the dollar value. Counts only transaction code P, a purchase at market; option exercises, grants and tax withholding are excluded because none of them is a decision to buy. Ranks over every row in the window — never a capped slice — and reports rows_considered so a cut is never silent. Sourced from SEC Forms 3/4/5.

exclude_funds.description: Drop issuers that are funds reporting unitholders, not operating companies with real insiders (e.g. a BDC or interval fund). Best-effort name/security-type heuristic. Default false.

group_by.description: How to roll transactions up before ranking. "filing" (default): sum every row on the same Form 4 into one total — a filing often reports one decision as several price-band lines, and a price-band row has no economic meaning on its own. "row": rank individual transaction lines. "owner": sum every filing by the same insider against the same issuer across the whole window (e.g. several purchases over several days).

include_suspect.description: Include transactions whose price looks like a filer data-entry error (see the caveat). Default false — suspect rows are excluded from rankings.

issuer.description: Limit to one issuer — ticker (e.g. "LEN") or SEC CIK. Substring match on issuer name also works.

min_value_usd.description: Ignore transactions below this dollar value.

owner.description: Limit to one insider — name substring (e.g. "Berkshire") or SEC CIK.

since.description: Earliest transaction date, ISO (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to the last 90 days of the loaded window.

name: insider_top_buyers
title: Insider Top Buyers
